output.post: Renders a 10,000-line git diff in 38ms — an order of magnitude faster than existing pagers. termdiff gives you side-by-side, word-level highlighting in your terminal with zero config. Ships as a single static binary, drops into your existing git aliases. {APP_URL} #git #diff
thread_extension: Most fancy diff tools slow down or misalign on large diffs. termdiff uses Rust + tree-sitter to parse and render precisely — even in monorepos.
It doesn’t replace your workflow. Set core.pager=termdiff and keep using 'git diff', 'git log -p', or your aliases. No config needed.
4,200+ engineers use it. It’s in Homebrew core and Terminal Trove. MIT licensed, open source, and built for maintainers who review diffs all day.
alt_variants: Default git diff output is unreadable for large changes. termdiff renders 10k-line diffs in 38ms with true side-by-side, word-level highlighting. {APP_URL}
Your diffs, side by side, in 38 milliseconds. termdiff is a zero-config, static binary that works with your existing git setup. {APP_URL}
